skills.name: Subtract pure fractions
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of fractions sharing a common denominator.

skills.name: Convert unlike denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and convert fractions to equivalent forms.

skills.name: Subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Subtract the integer components of whole or mixed numbers.

skills.name: Borrow from whole
skills.definition: Regroup one unit from the whole number part to the fraction part to resolve a negative fractional difference.

skills.name: Simplify fraction
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fractional component to its simplest form.
